negative_findings.reason: The provided IR slice for reports/pretty-link-ir-slice-rest.json contains no entry_points, and source verification did not uncover hidden WordPress REST registrations. The plugin bootstrap loads each controller via load_hooks() in plugins/pretty-link/pretty-link.php:201-213, but a full-text search of plugins/pretty-link for register_rest_route, rest_api_init, permission_callback, and WP_REST_* returned no matches. Refutation check on likely API-looking code showed PrliLocalApiController::load_hooks() is empty at plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliLocalApiController.php:7-9, while PrliXmlRpcController registers xmlrpc_methods instead of REST routes at plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliXmlRpcController.php:11-25. Conclusion: no in-scope register_rest_route() entry points exist for Agent A3 in this source tree.
